title: The Ugly Duckling
moral: Everyone grows in their own way and in their own time; being different is nothing to be ashamed of, and kindness to someone who feels different can help them find where they belong.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Once upon a time, beside a quiet pond on a little farm, Mama Duck sat on her nest among the tall green reeds.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: She had been keeping her eggs warm for a long, long time, and today was a very special day.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, playful sound words
lines.text: Crack! Crack! Crack! One, two, three fluffy yellow ducklings popped out of their shells.

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: loving, delighted mother
lines.text: Hello, my little darlings! Welcome to the world!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: But one egg was still waiting. It was bigger than the others, and a little bit speckled.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, a little suspense, gentle
lines.text: Mama Duck waited, and waited. And then... crack!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Out tumbled a big, grey, fluffy duckling with long legs and big flat feet.

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: surprised, then warm and welcoming
lines.text: Oh! Well, aren't you a big one! Welcome, little one. I shall call you Ollie.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: The next morning, the ducklings looked at Ollie with big round eyes.

lines.speaker: DUCKLINGS
lines.performance_direction: three small ducklings speaking together, curious and a little rude, not mean
lines.text: Why are you so grey? Why are your feet so big? You don't look like us at all!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Ollie looked at his grey feathers, and he looked at their bright yellow ones, and he felt a little lump in his throat.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: a small, soft voice, hurt and unsure
lines.text: Maybe there's something wrong with me.

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: gentle, firm, loving
lines.text: There is nothing wrong with you, Ollie. Every one of my ducklings is special in their own way.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Mama Duck tucked him under her wing, and for a little while Ollie felt warm and safe.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: That afternoon, Mama Duck led her ducklings down to the pond for their very first swim.

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: cheerful, encouraging teacher
lines.text: Paddle, paddle, little ones! Kick your feet, just like me!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: The yellow ducklings wobbled and splashed. But Ollie glided across the water as smoothly as a leaf on the breeze.

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: proud, delighted
lines.text: Look at Ollie! What a wonderful swimmer!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: But when Ollie tried to quack, out came a funny honk instead. Honk!

lines.speaker: DUCKLINGS
lines.performance_direction: giggling together, teasing
lines.text: Honk? Ducks don't honk! You're a funny-looking, funny-sounding duck!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, tender
lines.text: Ollie paddled away into the reeds, all by himself. Two big tears dripped off the end of his beak.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: That evening, as the sun went down, Ollie made a big decision.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: quiet, brave but sad
lines.text: I don't fit in here. I'll go and find a place where I belong.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: So while everyone was sleeping, Ollie waddled away along the reedy path, out into the big wide world.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: He looked back just once, at the little pond glowing in the evening light. Then he kept on walking.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Ollie walked for days and days, until he came to a great big lake. The leaves on the trees turned red and gold, and they floated down onto the water.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Ollie asked the frogs if he could live with them, but frogs live in the mud. He asked the hens on a farm, but hens don't swim.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: lonely, wondering
lines.text: Isn't there anyone like me, anywhere?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, full of wonder
lines.text: Then, high above him, came a sound like gentle music. A family of beautiful white swans was flying south, their long necks stretched out and their wings shining in the sun.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: amazed, longing, whispering
lines.text: Oh... they're the most beautiful birds I've ever seen. I wish I could be like them.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Then winter came. Snow covered the ground, and the river turned to ice.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, tender
lines.text: Ollie was cold and hungry, and very, very lonely. He curled up in the snow by the frozen river and shivered.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Just then, a little round face popped out of a hole in the riverbank. It was Ottie the Otter.

lines.speaker: OTTIE
lines.performance_direction: kind, bubbly, warm-hearted
lines.text: Oh, you poor thing! You're shivering! Come inside, quickly. My burrow is warm and cosy.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: shy, surprised
lines.text: You want me to come in? Even though I'm grey, and gangly, and I honk?

lines.speaker: OTTIE
lines.performance_direction: laughing kindly
lines.text: Of course! You don't have to look like anyone else to be my friend. Come on!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: All winter long, Ollie stayed with Ottie. They shared fish soup, told stories, and slid on the ice together.

lines.speaker: OTTIE
lines.performance_direction: playful, laughing
lines.text: Wheee! Your big feet are perfect for sliding, Ollie!

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: laughing, happy for the first time
lines.text: Honk! Honk! This is the most fun I've ever had!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: And slowly, without even noticing, Ollie grew. His neck grew longer, his wings grew stronger, and his grey feathers began to change.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: At last, spring arrived. The ice melted, the flowers bloomed, and the birds sang again.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: grateful, warm
lines.text: Thank you, Ottie. You were my friend when I had nobody. I'll never forget it.

lines.speaker: OTTIE
lines.performance_direction: warm, encouraging
lines.text: Go and find your place, Ollie. And come back to visit!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Ollie stretched his wings, and to his surprise they lifted him up into the sky. He was flying!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Ollie flew until he came back to the great lake, sparkling in the spring sunshine. And there, gliding on the water, were the beautiful white swans.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: nervous, small voice
lines.text: They'll probably laugh at me, like everyone else. But I want to say hello, just once.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: So Ollie landed softly on the water and bowed his head, waiting for them to laugh.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, full of wonder
lines.text: But as he bowed his head, he saw his reflection in the clear, still water.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: He wasn't a grey, gangly duckling any more. Looking back at him was a beautiful white swan, with a long graceful neck and shining feathers.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: astonished, whispering
lines.text: Is that... is that me?

lines.speaker: SWAN
lines.performance_direction: graceful, kind, welcoming
lines.text: Welcome, young swan! We have been waiting for you. Will you swim with us?

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: joyful, emotional
lines.text: Yes! Oh yes, I'd love to!

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: For the first time, Ollie knew exactly where he belonged.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: But Ollie had not forgotten the little pond, or Mama Duck. One sunny morning, he flew home to visit.

lines.speaker: DUCKLINGS
lines.performance_direction: amazed, together
lines.text: Wow! Look at that beautiful swan!

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: recognising him, overjoyed
lines.text: Ollie? Is that you? My Ollie!

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: warm, happy
lines.text: Hello, Mama. I'm a swan! I was a swan all along.

lines.speaker: DUCKLINGS
lines.performance_direction: sorry, sincere, together
lines.text: We're sorry we teased you, Ollie. We didn't understand that you were just different.

lines.speaker: OLLIE
lines.performance_direction: kind, forgiving
lines.text: That's all right. Being different isn't wrong. It just means growing in your own way.

lines.speaker: MAMA
lines.performance_direction: proud, tender
lines.text: I always knew you were special, Ollie. Not because you are a swan, but because you are you.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: From then on, Ollie spent his days gliding on the great lake with the swans, and visiting the little pond with Mama Duck and the ducklings.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: And Ottie the Otter came to visit too, and they all splashed and played together in the sunshine.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling
lines.text: Because everyone grows in their own way, and in their own time.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, the moral, slow and clear
lines.text: And a little kindness can help anyone find the place where they belong.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.performance_direction: warm, gentle storyteller for small children, unhurried, smiling, closing
lines.text: The end.
